{{Quote|Putting an end to a three-month scandal in the halls of higher learning on Alderaan, Provost Dalus Othona formally censured and suspended Dean Halcor Raystel.|HoloNet News's article on the event|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Provost''' was a position at the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]] held<ref name="HNN" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="22 BBY">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_2.html|Dean of Aldera Suspended}} is set on the date 13:3:14, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> by [[Dalus Othona]], who held the authority to suspend members of the faculty.<ref name="HNN" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="22 BBY" /> Othona censured and punished [[Dean/Legends|Dean]] [[Halcor Raystel]] after numerous cases of undesirable conduct. The [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported on the situation on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:3:14.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Provost was mentioned in "Dean of Aldera Suspended," an article<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="HNN" /> on [[March 14]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN47 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> In real life, [[Wikipedia:Provost (education)|provosts]] are high-ranking academic administrators in universities.<ref name="Dict">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/provost|text=Provost Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20220519134952}}</ref>
